intent: A dark, monochrome activity timeline grouped by day, filtered by type and person, showing what changed inline: word-level diffs, before/after values, status moves and quoted comments.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with @container queries; colour tokens as CSS variables; color-mix() for diff tints
stack.animation: motion/react: layoutId for the chip pill, layout='position' and AnimatePresence popLayout for refiltering, height for diff toggles
stack.icons: lucide-react (ArrowRight, CircleDot, MessageSquare, Pencil, UserPlus, X)
stack.fonts: font-display (Geist) heading, font-sans (Geist) UI, font-mono (Geist Mono) times, counts, days, values

layout.card: surface, 1px line, 14px radius, inset highlight + deep shadow, overflow hidden; 720px max in the demo
layout.header: title + mono workspace line; 32px avatar filter on the right; type chips with counts below; Clear appears when filtered
layout.dayHeading: mono 11px uppercase: day (muted), date (faint), hairline, count
layout.event: grid 28px node + content; node is a ringed circle with the type icon; 1px rail joins nodes within a day; sentence with actor and target in ink, mono time right

changes.text: sunken box, after-sentence with removed words struck on red tint and added words on green tint
changes.value: mono 12px before (struck, red tint) → after (green tint)
changes.status: two pills with an arrow; the new one raised and in ink

layout.empty: ringed icon, ‘No comments from Sam this week’, Show everything

typography.sentence: 14px, leading 1.45, muted; names and targets medium ink

color.approach: greyscale; semantic added/removed tints only behind text; one accent for the active count and selected person ring

motion.order: card → header rows 60ms apart → day headings and events in reading order, 45ms apart from 0.26s
motion.filter: chip pill slides on spring 500/40; staying events glide (layout position); leaving fade up 6px with 4px blur (0.18s); arriving stagger 30ms

responsive.390: avatars stay beside the title; type chips wrap onto a second line, every label fully visible; diffs wrap
responsive.576+: all chips sit on one line

accessibility: type chips are a tablist with roving tabindex and arrow keys
person avatars are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) labelled ‘Only <name>’
each day is a labelled section; the feed is aria-live polite
diffs use <ins>/<del>; values add sr-only ‘was’/‘now’; each event starts with an sr-only type

content.events: Mara rewrote the Pricing headline (text diff); Priya commented on it; Jonas moved Pricing page v3 In review → Approved; Mara changed Pro $24 → $29 / seat; Sam added Elif Demir as a viewer; Jonas renamed Team → Studio; Priya asked ‘seat’ or ‘member’; Sam moved v3 Draft → In review; Mara edited the annual note (15% → 20%)
content.people: Mara Ilić, Jonas Weber, Priya Raman, Sam Okoye

avoid: a coloured icon per event type
full-width code diff blocks for one-word changes
